name: Cyberpunk 2077
notes: DirectX 12 only, so it needs D3DMetal (import the Game Porting Toolkit). Patch 2.0+ requires AVX, which needs macOS 15 or newer. Not yet verified on Isthmus.

name: ELDEN RING
notes: DirectX 12 only. Easy Anti-Cheat guards online play, so expect offline mode only. Not yet verified on Isthmus.

name: Baldur's Gate 3
notes: Skips Larian's launcher, which is the most common point of failure. There's also a native macOS version on Steam if you own it there. Not yet verified on Isthmus.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
notes: Use the DirectX 11 executable (bin\x64\witcher3.exe); the DX12 build needs D3DMetal. Not yet verified on Isthmus.

name: One More Lawn
notes: Unreal Engine; links DirectX 11 and 12 and runs its DX11 path on DXMT. Verified on Isthmus 0.2.0, engine 26.3.0-i1, M5 Max, macOS 26.6.2: launched through Steam and the game process ran for 43 minutes. Frame rate not measured.
